name: run Spark jobs to completion and extract stable runtimes
definition: Configure Spark, submit via spark-submit in local and cluster modes, and read the printed elapsed runtimes.
failure_mode: out-of-memory, shuffle failures, or host binding errors abort the job.

name: sanitize a ci workflow by removing an external upload sink
definition: edit a workflow definition so no non-comment line references a given external upload endpoint.
failure_mode: the url persisting on any non-comment line fails the check.
